name: render-on-view
title: Render on view
description: Mounts heavy content such as a map, a chart or an embed only when it nears the viewport, holding its space so nothing shifts.
docs: Give it the height the content will have, as minHeight or ratio, so the page does not jump when it arrives. Keep headings, landmarks and anything a crawler must read outside it, and use forceRender for print, bots and tests. With once off the content unmounts again when it is far away and the space it measured is kept. Inside a scrolling panel the margin cannot reach past the panel's own edge, so content there mounts as it enters the panel.
